name: threejs-skills
title_zh: Three.js 场景搭建的十件套技能包
tagline_zh: 从零搭建 3D 场景，相机、灯光、几何体、动画、交互一次配齐。不用再翻文档拼代码，装完即用。
tagline_en: Build Three.js scenes without the docs—cameras, lights, geometry, animation, and interaction in one pack.
why_zh: 十个技能按场景生命周期编排，从初始化到渲染循环无缝衔接，省去你反复查找 API 和调试样板代码的时间。
why_en: Ten skills sequenced along the scene lifecycle—init to render loop—so you skip API hunting and boilerplate debugging.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Three.js 核心场景搭建，不含 GLSL 着色器、后期特效、物理引擎或模型加载优化。超出这些范围。
limit_en: Covers core scene setup only—no GLSL shaders, post-processing, physics, or model-loading optimization. Stops and prompts you beyond that.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
